children.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
A run that ended stays as it ended
A cycle is run once
A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
A second run is refused while the first is running
A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
A run identity is started once
A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
Reading a run's progress changes nothing
The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
The run projects filed verdicts and unreached items into tagged Allure results
